question: The interface vocabulary has no term for a desktop editor or for the Agent Client Protocol (ACP); should a term such as acp be added?
why: zed-pro uses unknown and zed-personal uses cli (for the eval-cli binary) because ACP, the protocol through which Claude Agent, Codex, OpenCode, Copilot, Cursor and Pi attach, fits no listed interface token (AGENTS.md section 2 rule 12).
